title: Mimic: The GitHub Tool That Turns Any App Into Python Code
description:
Somebody built a tool that takes any app and just hands it back to you as Python code 🔥

It's called Mimic. The way it works, it watches an app under the hood and captures all its network requests, then Claude reads through them and turns the whole thing into a ready to use Python library. You literaly just grab it and run it yourself.

What got me is the speed of it, almost 700 stars in like two days 😅 people clearly been waiting for something like this. Any app becomes your own personal code, basicaly.

If you wanna check it, search GitHub for littledivy mimic ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
